from store import Store
from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection
from cleanup import cleanup_setup

# Scenario from README: failed setup "one"\''s cleanup is queued; setup "two" completes first.
store = Store()
begin_setup(store, "w", "one")          # "one" pending, then fails
begin_setup(store, "w", "two")
complete_setup(store, "w", "two", "connection-two")   # "two" now active for w
print("active before cleanup:", active_connection(store, "w"))
cleanup_setup(store, "w", "one")        # queued cleanup for failed "one" runs
print("active after  cleanup:", active_connection(store, "w"))
'
